messages:
Lina (CS): FYI - Nexon onboarding health dipped yesterday: success rate on the botintent flow fell ~15% and support mentioned a few slow responses. Renewal check-in in ~4 weeks. I'd like to propose a controlled pilot: move non-escalation traffic to a compact int8 model + set an explicit routing rule for escalations to remain on current model. Thoughts? :megaphone:
Devon (SRE): Saw that spike. p95 latency jumped during long-context sessions. Quick numbers from the window:
```
window: 2026-03-20 02:00-14:00 UTC
p50: 190ms
p95: 630ms
median_tokens: 380
requests: 12.4k
```
Devon (SRE): Operationally we can do a gradual ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% with metrics checks at each step. Need a clear eval metric for customer-facing quality to avoid churn.
Priya (ML): On Nexon's prompt distribution the compact-int8 candidate (rdx-lite-1) shows small quality drift: acceptability down ~0.6% on our rubric, hallucination rate roughly unchanged. Recommend also enabling prefix cache for repeated templates and a token-budget cap on fallback to the larger model for >800 token completions.
Priya (ML): Suggested plan:
- Canary: rdx-lite-1-int8 3% traffic for 72h
- Ramp: 3% -> 10% after 24h if p95 latency improves and nightly eval passes
- Eval: nightly_metrics + sampled human spot-check (5/day)
- Gates: auto-rollback if nightly_acceptability_drop > 1% OR escalations increase by >10% vs baseline
ops-bot: Pilot blueprint created: https://internal.redwood/pilots/nexon-compact-int8 (internal)
Devon (SRE): Routing rule draft (pseudo-config):
```
routing:
  - match: tag:escalation OR priority:high
    target: rdx-standard-2
  - match: else
    target: weighted(rdx-lite-1-int8:0.03, rdx-standard-2:0.97)
    fallback: rdx-standard-2
```
Lina (CS): Love the plan. I'll prepare a short customer note explaining the pilot and mitigation (we'll revert immediately if we see regressions). Can someone write a 1-line tech summary I can paste?
Priya (ML): Paste: "Weare running a small, monitored pilot that directs low-risk bot traffic to a compact quantized variant to reduce latency variability and cost; high-priority/escalation traffic will remain on the current model and all changes are auto-gated by nightly quality checks."
Devon (SRE): Add that we will capture request tags so Nexon can opt their own flows out if desired. Also, I'll set up alerts in PagerDuty if rollback is triggered.
Lina (CS): Assignments: @Priya owns evaluation rubric and human spot-checks, @Devon owns routing & rollback automation, Iown customer comms + renewal note. I'll add this to the renewal playbook row and schedule a 20-min sync with Nexon ops tomorrow 10am PT.
ops-bot: Canary deployed to us-east-1 at 03:12 UTC, traffic 3%. Dash: https://dash.internal/redwood/pilot/nexon-compact (internal)
Lina (CS): Action items checklist: 1) Priya: push nightly eval and create a 5-example human spot-check set; 2) Devon: implement routing rule and PD escalation; 3) Me: send customer note + enablement invite. Will report back after 24h first-check. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
